title: Calibration execution guardrails: staleness detector, artifact quarantine, and accuracy handoff playbook
creator: Sofia Kim
description:
Problem: Calibration runs (FP8/INT8 sweeps) produce artifacts and intermediate snapshots that can drift, become stale, or fail accuracy gates after downstream model changes. Operators need deterministic behavior: quarantine bad artifacts early, surface accuracy regressions, and enforce TTL/retention and permission controls so users and infra teams can safely promote artifacts without surprise regressions.

Goal: Deliver a calibration execution guardrails module in the Redwood Console that provides: a) runtime staleness detection for calibration runs, b) automated artifact quarantine and TTL policies, c) an accuracy validation handoff flow that wires calibration outputs into the existing evals pipeline with clear pass/fail semantics, and d) RBAC controls and audit trails for promotion and deletion workflows. This ticket coordinates PM design and eng to define UX, policies, and acceptance criteria for the first MVP.
acceptance_criteria: Console shows per-run staleness score and reason (model-binary-change | dataset-drift | config-mismatch) on run summary
Calibration artifacts that fail post-run accuracy validation are automatically moved to 'quarantine' and marked read-only
Admins can configure TTL policies per-project and per-sensitivity tier; expired artifacts move to 'archived' with a one-week pending-delete window
Promotion flow requires a signed approval from both an approver role and a QA evaluator if accuracy delta >= 0.5 BLEU/ROUGE/other metric
All quarantine/promote/delete actions generate immutable audit events (user, timestamp, reason, source-run) surfaced in Console and exportable via API
Evaluation handoff triggers an eval job and links the eval report to the run; failure blocks auto-promotion and emits an alert to the owning team
tasks: Draft UX mockups for run status states: healthy | stale | quarantined | archived
Define staleness heuristics and thresholds with Applied ML (inputs: model checksum, dataset fingerprint, config diff, last-run timestamp)
Spec artifact lifecycle states and TTL transitions; draft retention policy knobs in Console settings
Design RBAC roles: artifact-owner, artifact-approver, artifact-archivist; map to existing SSO groups
Integrate eval trigger webhook: calibration -> evals -> return verdict and metrics
Create audit schema and export API contract for legal/compliance teams
progress_comments: 2026-03-02 Sofia Kim: Kickoff with Applied ML and Infra. Agreed to prototype staleness heuristics using model checksum + dataset fingerprint differential.
2026-03-04 Marco Ruiz (Applied ML): Initial heuristics: checksum mismatch = high-confidence stale; dataset KL-divergence > 0.1 = likely stale. Need experimentation on threshold sensitivity.
2026-03-06 Aisha Patel: UX 1st draft uploaded to Drive (link below); includes quarantine modal and approval flow. Requesting design review from DES-128.
2026-03-08 Priya Nair (Infra): Blocking: storage lifecycle API needs an 'immutable-tag' feature to mark quarantined artifacts read-only; ENG-21045 opened.

2026-03-10 Sofia Kim: Next step: run a 2-week pilot with two customers on non-prod tenants to validate thresholds and TTL comfort levels.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Over-zealous staleness detection could quarantine valid artifacts and block releases. Mitigation: pilot on opt-in tenants; add manual override and two-step approval for quarantined promotions.
Risk: TTL defaults may conflict with compliance needs for regulated customers. Mitigation: expose per-tenant policy templates and allow export of archived artifacts prior to deletion.
Risk: Audit volume growth could increase storage and querying costs. Mitigation: sampled audit retention for low-sensitivity projects and compressed event export to S3.
Risk: Accuracy metric differences across tasks. Mitigation: allow project-level primary metric selection and tolerance config; provide metric normalization guidance in docs.
implementation_notes: Staleness detector to run as a post-run hook that computes: model checksum delta, dataset fingerprint delta, runtime-config diff; produce a single numeric staleness score (0-100)
Quarantine state should be implemented with metadata flag + storage ACL change (immutable-tag) to prevent accidental reads-only removal; artifact metadata stores a 'quarantine_reason' field
Retention engine will transition artifacts: active -> quarantined (if failed) -> archived (after TTL) -> pending_delete (7d) -> deleted

Promotion flow will require: 1) promotion request, 2) automated eval pass, 3) approver sign-off (UI and API), then artifact state flips to 'promoted' and snapshot exported to dedicated production bucket
Audit events will be appended to a write-optimized event store and exposed via the Console UI and a /runs/:id/audit API endpoint
